清晨，渡工沈青把铜钥匙交给修桥者沈青，两人是不同的人。渡口规约写明：东闸只能用铜钥匙开启。河面映着一条淡金色的光带。"]},{"documentId":"D4","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"茶摊老板数清十二只瓷杯，另买一袋茶叶；这件事不使用东闸或铜钥匙。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-A2M2","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Aa62f625a-3094-477e-85bf-56e563179437:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:a62f625a-3094-477e-85bf-56e563179437"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["茶摊老板数清十二只瓷杯，另买一袋茶叶；这件事不使用东闸或铜钥匙。"]},{"documentId":"D5","title":"已确认揭示","kind":"disclosure","text":"傍晚桥匠用工具箱里的铜钥匙开启东闸，完成护送承诺；青篙仍按午后听来的传言去茶摊寻找。","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"audienceKeys":["author"],"sequenceKey":"chapters:world/W-IXYPS-A2M2","spanRef":"evidence:v1:chapter%3Ares%3Av1%3Achapter%3Af56dfc0b-c335-4f2b-9a08-c2a61b0cb4e5:sub%3Av1%3A00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000101:literal","subjectRefs":[],"unitKey":"res:v1:chapter:f56dfc0b-c335-4f2b-9a08-c2a61b0cb4e5"},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["傍晚桥匠用工具箱里的铜钥匙开启东闸，完成护送承诺；青篙仍按午后听来的传言去茶摊寻找。"]},{"documentId":"D6","title":"沈青","kind":"entity","text":"沈青","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"沈青","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:76ae35ad-c190-412e-8e28-a703afef867a","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["沈青"]},{"documentId":"D7","title":"沈青","kind":"entity","text":"沈青","atom":{"modality":"established","value":{"aliases":[],"canonicalLabel":"沈青","entityType":"character","sourceIdentity":{"resourceKind":"character","sourceUid":"res:v1:character:fcb4d44f-41ae-4554-abad-b63ab9f54cd2","subKey":"root"}},"supporting":[]},"evidence":["沈青"]}]}
